messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-20260315-AuthService - JWT verification errors spike (8% error rate), auth latency p50 1200ms. Affected route: /v1/session/create. Please ack and investigate.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260315 acknowledged by alice at 2026-03-15T01:12:34Z

alice: acked. I'm checking jwks and recent deploys. quick glance shows a bunch of `kid` mismatch logs.

bob: seeing 401 surge, matching `kid` mismatch. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T01:11:02Z auth-service ERROR jwt.verify failed kid mismatch expected=abc123 got=def456 token_id=lkj324
2026-03-15T01:11:03Z auth-service ERROR jwks refresh failed 404 from key-provider
```

carla: did we rotate keys last hour? I remember a key-rotation job was enabled for staging then prod.

alice: yep there was a config push at 01:05 UTC that flipped `enable_auto_rotate=true` for prod keys. terraform apply by infra-pipeline.

dave: timeline matches. Key provider returned new JWKS without the old kid; some tokens in flight still use old kid -> verification fails.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable verifier fallback mapping to accept old kid; 2) revert auto-rotate; 3) serve old JWKS for few minutes. Which is fastest?

alice: fallback mapping is fastest. I can push a verifier config with allowed_kids list and TTL extension. Doing it now.

alice: applying hotfix: `POST /admin/verifier/config` payload:
```json
{"allowed_kids": ["abc123","def456"], "cache_ttl_seconds": 300}
```

incident-bot: Config change detected: verifier-config v2 deployed by alice @ 2026-03-15T01:15:10Z

bob: I see auth errors drop on the dashboard from 8% -> 1.2%. still some stragglers.

support: customer-impact: Login failures reported by 3 customers (acct-1001, acct-2244, acct-7788). Estimated affected requests ~2% of total login traffic between 01:10-01:16 UTC. Raising comms.

carla: I'll open a temporary route to old jwks endpoint on key-provider (edge proxy) to serve legacy keys for 10m. Handing off to infra to whitelist.

dave: infra routed old jwks back and set header `x-allow-legacy: true`. Confirmed by curl: `curl https://keys.prod.internal/.well-known/jwks.json` returns both keys.

alice: error rate now 0.35% and trending down. Latency normalized. Monitoring alerts quieting.

sre-oncall: nice. keep watch for 30m. Prepare postmortem notes: root cause = premature key rotation without zero-downtime strategy; no fallback mapping in verifier.

bob: handoff: I'm on-call until 02:00 UTC, after that carla takes over. I'm leaving the temp mappings and proxy route in place.

carla: ack handoff. I'll run a background job to reconcile token issuers and validate no stale tokens remain.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260315 status changed to: Mitigated by alice @ 2026-03-15T01:22:05Z

support: posting customer update: we mitigated an authentication disruption affecting a subset of login requests. Root cause being investigated; temporary workaround in place. ETA for follow-up 4h.

alice: creating RCA draft: actions - add canary for JWKS rotation, add verifier fallback config, extend deploy checklist to include in-flight token assessment, add integration test for key-rotation path.

sre-oncall: assigning postmortem to alice + carla. Will schedule 1hr RCA meeting 2026-03-15T09:00 UTC.

dave: will roll back `enable_auto_rotate=true` flag and schedule a staged rotation with traffic drain.

bob: closing detective log: `auth-service` returned 200 to 99.7% of requests last 10m. All alerts suppressed.

carla: leaving a note for support to refund affected customers if they escalate.

incident-bot: Closing note: Incident marked as resolved (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T01:35:10Z. Postmortem placeholder: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260315

alice: thanks all. follow-up item ids: PM-457 (deploy check), SRE-312 (canary for jwks), INFRA-901 (proxy legacy key serve).

sre-oncall: handing off final watch to carla. if error rate creeps above 1% reopen PD. Good job team. :thumbsup:
